title: HTTP 503: Cloud Connector cannot establish a tunnel to the backend
symptom: The deploy returns HTTP 503 with a message along the lines of: Cloud Connector cannot establish secure tunnel to back end.
rootCause: Not verified on our own systems. Per SAP-samples documentation: the SAP Cloud Connector cannot reach the on-premise backend system.

solutions.label: Check the Cloud Connector state
solutions.body:
1. Open the Cloud Connector admin UI and confirm the subaccount shows as Connected
2. Under Cloud To On-Premise, confirm the backend is listed with the right virtual host
3. Use the Cloud Connector's Check Availability function

solutions.label: Rule out a local firewall or proxy
solutions.body: A corporate firewall or proxy can block the connection. Try from a different network, or ask IT to open the relevant port.

prevention: Verify Cloud Connector reachability when setting up a new team member's environment, before handing them deployment work.
